study: Nested complete-state learning curve, exact expectations
predeclaration: Design fixed before running any smaller-size training or inspecting their test errors
nested_subsets: One family-balanced state ordering, shared by every model and optimizer seed
validation: All 96 recorded validation pairs, unchanged at every training size

quantum.selection: minimum validation MSE among initial and every-fifth-iteration checkpoints

film.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation MSE, checked at initialization and every iteration
film.configuration_selection: minimum mean validation MSE across all three seeds, independently at each size
film.input: 15 exact nonidentity two-qubit Pauli expectations and context vector

calibration: Exact untrained classical Gram formula; no fitted coefficients or labeled pairs required
primary_endpoint: test_joint MSE: fixed new states and held-out context cap
test_context_caveat: At smaller sizes some original test_context states are absent from training; overlap counts are in indices.json
reported_uncertainty: All three optimizer seeds, arithmetic mean and range; no dataset-resampling confidence interval
reuse_policy: Only pinned identical source/data/results and matching training configurations; saved checkpoint predictions are reevaluated
resource_scope: Counts are labeled source-state/context pairs, not physical quantum copies or measurement shots
runtime_scope: Per-run training times and new invocation wall time; reused training times remain historical
claims: No practical superiority is inferred from errors near numerical precision
A matched two-copy quantum model is a strong comparator
The known classical Gram formula is exact with exact Pauli features
One nested state sequence and three optimizer seeds are a diagnostic, not a general sample-complexity theorem
